name: Sora no Otoshimono -DokiDoki Summer Vacation-
original_name: そらのおとしもの -ドキドキサマーバケーション-
source:
One summer day, the memory network of Ikaros is suddenly initialized.... Tomoki and his friends try to give her shocks through various experiences. Will her memories and emotions successfully come back...?

[From Himeya Shop]
